title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - PowerSequenceContainer
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/PowerSequenceContainer. A container containing the various Power Sequences among which the EMS may choose for the appropriate Power Sequence at a given time. Subclass of Thing (http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing, not itself translated in this candidate).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PowerSequenceContainer'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasPowerSequence.description: Relationship. The various Sequences contained in a Power Sequence Container among which the EMS can choose the proper PowerSequence for the current energy demands. Relationship to PowerSequence.

hasPowerSequenceStatus.description: Property. This property indicates the current status of this Power Sequence. Controlled vocabulary (PowerSequenceStatus).

progress.description: Property. Time that has passed since the selected sequence has started. A value must be provided, unless no sequence has been selected or the selected sequence hasn't started yet. ISO 8601 duration (e.g. 'PT30M').
